transcript: This thing right here has helped me land clients bigger than I could have ever imagined. I sent whiskey bottles to 6, 7 and 8 figure business owners and I've locked the cap, attached a letter and if they want the code, they've got to call me. And I'm actually pretty blunt in the letter. I tell them exactly how I know how I can make them more money, save them money and kill a headache they've probably had for years. And then I tell them to call me even if it's just to tell me to f*** off. Most business owners are curious though and they like good booze, so they want to open the bottle. So they call and within 2 minutes we're talking about what I can do for them. That's a difference between cold calling someone and having someone already curious before you've even said a word. I've sneakily figured out how to turn a cold prospect into a very warm one. And I don't ask the crazy setup fees. I don't lead with a retainer contract and I don't have them sign ridiculous contracts. I run a test and if my AI solutions make them money, I get a cut of it. If it doesn't, they've lost nothing. And it all starts with getting their attention with this and this.

frame0_text: FROM LOCKED BOTTLE TO BOOKED CALL IN 2 MINUTES

who_is_called_out: The viewer is implied to be someone interested in landing '6, 7 and 8 figure business owners' as clients, or someone looking for effective lead generation strategies.
setting_and_production: The main speaker is filmed in a well-lit indoor setting with a modern wooden slatted wall background. B-roll includes various business environments like a cafe, office, and meeting room. The framing is a medium close-up for the speaker. The production quality is high, with clear audio and dynamic text overlays. Key phrases are highlighted with large, animated yellow and green text, while the full transcript appears in white.

Explains the 'thing': sending locked whiskey bottles to high-figure business owners, requiring a call for the code.
Details the letter's content: how he can make/save them money and solve problems, with a blunt call to action.
